title: Which way
goals: Reach the far end of the aisles.
The program asks the door whether it is locked.
starting_code:
# Ask the door whether it is locked.
# If it is, take the long way round!
hints: Ask the door what it knows with `door.locked`, and use `print` to see the answer.
Because the door is locked, you must walk around the shelves.
Move right, then up, then left to reach the far end.
intro: The short way up the aisles is through that door, {wizard}. Ask the door whether it is locked first, so you know which way to go.
outro: Very wise. Always look before you walk, especially when exploring an old castle.
learned: Now you know what an attribute is, and how to see one with `print`.
